item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya connects an LED to a dry cell in her school science lab in Jaipur. The LED allows current to flow through it in one direction only. Which connection will make the LED glow?

options.A: Either way of connecting the LED, because it behaves like a small filament bulb
options.B: The longer leg of the LED connected to the negative terminal of the cell
options.C: The longer leg of the LED connected to the positive terminal of the cell
options.D: The LED will glow only if two cells are used, whichever way it is connected
